b9.the_hobs_share_out_the_raskghar_hoard.summary: Two hours later the Hobs bring up the Raskghar's hoard from a store room below: coins, gems and goblets, but no artifacts. They split it between three teams who fought below, and leave out the Silver Swords. Erin takes nothing. The teams count over a hundred thousand gold.
b9.the_hobs_share_out_the_raskghar_hoard.news: The Redfang Goblins brought up the Raskghar's hoard and gave it all away to three adventurer teams.

foreshadow.text: The Redfang Hobs have borrowed both of Erin's bags of holding and gone down into the dungeon. They say they know where the Raskghar kept their loot.

stage.line: Coins, gems and goblets lie in heaps on the upstairs floor. Three teams of adventurers stare, and five Hobs look very pleased with themselves.

beats.line: No, I'm not taking any. I wasn't down there, you were!
The Hobs tip out both bags of holding until the floor shines with gold.
For you. Not for the Silver Swords.
A third each? Dead gods. I could hug a Goblin right now.
We take it. And we leave that dungeon to somebody else.
I counted twice and lost count twice. A hundred thousand, give or take a lot?
